target: An actually delivered public-state rolling controller for R1 loaded release -> R2 same finite-tray reuse and shared occupancy -> later R1 protection, with all five jobs nonregressing under the normal matching contract. Actual coupling existence is established only for this finite synthetic mechanism; solver necessity and original-airport usefulness remain open.
minimal_new_implementation: New source-only context builder consumes the existing sealed initial or later owner collection, retained terminal prefix and current immutable action ledger. No case label, native output, peer private endpoint or native fork enters selection.

New separate continuation predictor seeds all five jobs, all three trays, mandatory Storage, observed moving entries/exit bounds, known service and hold epochs, target occupancy/reservations and FIFO from that context. Already completed prefix and issued actions cannot change.

Explicitly support the actual message policy: ordinary collection, bounded fresh pair, own ACK refresh and historical final-entry facts. Do not reuse the old normal-exchange timing assumption. Unsupported event-order/headway or unresolved-state facts return unknown.

Use one shared candidate evaluator for ordinary strict coordinate search, plateau coordinate search, two-coordinate destroy/repair LNS adaptation, and finite MPC enumeration. Only the search neighborhood/order differs; tie rules and budget are frozen before prospective execution.

Execute only the currently lawful first action from a proposal, then solve again at A's actual first return and B's actual reuse route collection. Later replanning may not rewrite the earlier return or committed prefix. No handwritten unconditional 7->8 replacement stands in for prediction.

information_and_budget.unknowns: Every method sees the same support/unknown rules; unresolved candidates remain in its budget and denominator.
information_and_budget.prefix_rule: At phase B the already-issued return is fixed; any duplicate action labels and cache reuse must be declared identically for all methods, not silently counted as fewer searches.
information_and_budget.matching_baseline: The present domain fixes the feasible tray/job assignment (L reuses at7; E serves receiver). A matching-only method is therefore degenerate and must not be advertised as a strong competing optimizer. A resource-time matching reference must optimize the same route/window alternatives, or be reported as the identical finite MPC reference. Expanding assignment freedom requires a separately authorized domain.
information_and_budget.fairness: Same initial snapshots and source-access/message rules for every method. Later states can differ because prior legal actions differ; do not falsely claim byte-identical later observations across divergent trajectories.
information_and_budget.internal_search: MPC/LNS and coordinate methods may evaluate temporarily unprotected internal proposals. The common deployment rule and eventual strict native all-job comparison stay unchanged.
information_and_budget.cost: All current-state acquisition, validation, context setup, copying, candidate computation, output, native command/ACK handling and required descendants remain charged. No projection-only timing becomes a full-request100ms claim.

source_and_pure_gate_before_actual_metho: Validate context authority and reject missing/changed completion prefix, current L, late/future/expired messages, unresolved actions, unsupported service transitions and incomplete occupancy.

Reproduce the new fixed96 actual chosen continuations from source-derived semantics where supported, retaining all errors. Existing traces were used for debugging: call them retrospective conformance, not held-out validation.
Chosen-continuation agreement alone does not validate every counterfactual suffix. Mark remaining prediction uncertainty and require actual five-job terminal evidence for any efficacy claim.
Prove identical immutable context/candidate domain and ceiling32/4 for all four searches; deterministic tie/order/stop and plateau/multi-step reachability checks stay visible.

smallest_prospective_method_campaign_for.scope: All three frozen physical inputs, no parameter tuning; a future plan must pin whichever new message-policy version is actually accepted.
smallest_prospective_method_campaign_for.status: Not yet a dispatch registration. Final source/current-state support and measured preparation cost must determine a bounded shared wall budget before execution.
smallest_prospective_method_campaign_for.references: New online restricted MPC arms use the same lawful predictor. Existing complete native16 families are separately labeled offline counterfactual references; their best labels never enter a policy. An incomplete family remains unknown.
smallest_prospective_method_campaign_for.claims: If ordinary MPC/LNS matches the proposed method, report that explanation directly. Do not present a finite enumeration optimum or a coupled causal witness as new solver novelty.
